tools.name: fs
tools.description:
📂 Default for Markdown notes at /Notebook/Folder/Doc: browse, read, write, replace, grep, reorder, move, delete. For local edits, copy old text from read into replace; write(overwrite=true) replaces the entire body. Follow nextWindow for more content. Use block/av for native structures or database cells.
Actions (required fields): ls(path) · tree(path) · read(path) · write(path, markdown) · replace(path, edit) · rm*(path) · mv*(from, to) · reorder(path, orderedPaths) · search(path, query)
* = ask the user to confirm first. action="help" (topic=<action>) returns optional fields, nested shapes, and examples.

path.description: Workspace path such as /Notebook/Folder/Doc (notebook name may be omitted only if unambiguous). / lists notebooks.

blockStart.description: Zero-based display-block index to start reading from (default 0)

blockLimit.description: Optional maximum complete display blocks. Omit to try full text, subject to the 256 KiB hard content limit.

tokenBudget.description: Optional soft token budget. Complete blocks may exceed it, but never the 256 KiB hard content limit.

includeBlockIds.description: Include a sidecar blockRefs mapping without adding block IDs to Markdown content (default false)

markdown.description: Markdown content to create or write. Do not include a leading # Title; a matching create-time H1 is stripped automatically.

overwrite.description: When true, replace an existing document body while keeping the document node and title. This is a full body replacement.

edit.description: One replacement edit or an array of edits to apply sequentially inside editable non-complex Markdown blocks without rebuilding the document Read action="help", topic="<action>" before constructing this nested value.

orderedPaths.description: Every visible direct child path under path, each exactly once, in the new order.

query.description: Text or regular expression to search for

regex.description: Treat query as a JavaScript regular expression

tools.title: SiYuan Filesystem

tools.name: notebook
tools.description:
📚 Notebooks by notebook ID: list, create, open/close, rename, icon, config, root child docs, and MCP read/write permissions.
Actions (required fields): list() · create(name) · set_open_state(notebook, opened) · remove*(notebook) · rename(notebook, name) · get_conf(notebook) · set_conf(notebook, conf) · set_icon(notebook, icon) · get_permissions() · set_permission*(notebook, permission) · get_child_docs(notebook)
* = ask the user to confirm first. action="help" (topic=<action>) returns optional fields, nested shapes, and examples.

icon.description: Optional notebook icon. Prefer a Unicode hex code string such as '1f4d4' for 📔 instead of a raw emoji character.

opened.description: true to open, false to close

permission.description: Permission level: "none" blocks all access, "r" allows read only, "rw" allows read and write without delete, "rwd" allows read, write, and delete

tools.title: SiYuan Notebooks

tools.name: document
tools.description:
📝 Document IDs, metadata, outline, daily notes, and heading↔doc conversion; prefer fs for Markdown read/write. create uses notebook + notebook-local path (/Folder/Doc, omit notebook name). lookup accepts id, notebook+hpath, or notebook+path (.sy storage path); reuse returned storage paths for rename/move/remove. Read create help for parentPath + title.
Actions (required fields): create(notebook, path | notebook, parentPath, title) · lookup() · ensure_link_targets(notebook, parentId, mode, targets) · rename(title) · remove*() · move*() · reorder(parentID, orderedIDs) · get_child_blocks(id) · get_child_docs(id) · set_attr(id, attrs) · list_tree(notebook, path) · search_docs(notebook, query) · get_doc(id) · get_outline(id) · create_daily_note(notebook) · duplicate(id) · heading_to_doc(headingID, targetNotebook) · doc_to_heading(srcID, targetID)
* = ask the user to confirm first. action="help" (topic=<action>) returns optional fields, nested shapes, and examples.

path.description: create: notebook-local human path such as /Folder/Doc, never including the notebook name. lookup/list_tree/search_docs/rename/remove/move: .sy storage path from document(action="lookup").

parentPath.description: Parent for title-based create: notebook-local path (/Folder, no notebook name) or .sy storage path from lookup.

title.description: Required together with parentPath when create omits path; notebook + title alone is invalid

markdown.description: Markdown content, defaults to empty. Do not include a leading # Title; a matching H1 is stripped automatically.

icon.description: Optional document icon. Prefer a Unicode hex code string such as '1f4d4' for 📔 instead of a raw emoji character.

hpath.description: Human-readable notebook-local path to look up when notebook is provided. MUST NOT include the notebook name (e.g., /Folder/Doc, not /Notebook/Folder/Doc)

parentId.description: Explicit parent document ID. Only direct child documents of this resolved parent are in scope.

mode.description: resolve/reuse accept exact existing IDs without title fallback; create accepts explicit new titles and refuses to adopt same-title children.

targets.description: Explicit link targets. keys must be unique; IDs are identities, while titles are only new-document names. Read action="help", topic="<action>" before constructing this nested value.

dryRun.description: Plan and inspect the explicit scope without creating documents. For strict creation preflight, use validateOnly=true instead.

ids.description: One or more document IDs to remove

paths.description: One or more storage paths to remove in batch

fromPaths.description: Source storage paths returned by document(action="lookup").

toPath.description: Target storage path. Use the storage path of an existing destination document returned by document(action="lookup").

parentID.description: Notebook ID or parent document ID

orderedIDs.description: Complete ordered list of all visible direct child document IDs

icon.description: Icon value. Prefer a Unicode hex code string such as '1f4d4'.

cover.description: Cover source. Use null or empty string to clear the cover.

maxDepth.description: Max tree depth to return (default 3). Deeper nodes are collapsed to childCount.

query.description: Keyword to search in document titles

blockStart.description: Zero-based display-block index to start reading from in markdown mode (default 0)

blockLimit.description: Optional maximum complete display blocks in markdown mode. Omit to try full text, subject to the 256 KiB hard content limit.

tokenBudget.description: Optional soft token budget for markdown. Complete blocks may exceed it, but never the 256 KiB hard content limit.

includeBlockIds.description: Include a sidecar blockRefs mapping in markdown mode without adding block IDs to content (default false)

preview.description: Use SiYuan preview-mode outline semantics (default false)

app.description: Optional app identifier passed through to SiYuan

headingID.description: Heading block ID to convert into a document

targetID.description: Target document or heading block ID

after.description: When true, insert after the target heading instead of before it

tools.title: SiYuan Documents

tools.name: block
tools.description:
🧱 Native structure and metadata by block ID; prefer fs for ordinary Markdown edits. Read get_kramdown before replace: it matches only that block, not children or a heading section. update is best for one block (a table/code block can be multiline); use insert/append/prepend for sibling blocks.
Actions (required fields): insert() · prepend(dataType, data, parentID) · append(dataType, data, parentID) · update() · replace(id, edit) · delete*(id) · move*() · set_fold_state(id, folded) · get_kramdown(id) · batch_kramdown(ids) · get_children(id) · transfer_references(fromID, toID) · set_attrs(id, attrs) · get_attrs(id) · info(id) · breadcrumb(id) · dom(id) · recent_updated() · word_count(ids) · add_to_daily_note(notebook, dataType, data, position) · docs_info()
* = ask the user to confirm first. action="help" (topic=<action>) returns optional fields, nested shapes, and examples.

previousID.description: Sibling block ID to place after. For move, give previousID, parentID, or both.

parentID.description: Parent block or document ID. With prepend/append, a document ID targets the document head or tail; a block ID targets that block's child list.

blocks.description: Blocks to insert. Item-level anchors override top-level parentID/previousID/nextID.

edit.description: One replacement edit or an array of edits to apply sequentially within the same block kramdown Read action="help", topic="<action>" before constructing this nested value.

ids.description: Block IDs to move as a group, in the desired final order.

folded.description: true to fold, false to unfold

excludeTypes.description: Optional block types to exclude from the breadcrumb

count.description: Maximum number of recent readable blocks to return after permission filtering

position.description: Where to add content in today's daily note

tools.title: SiYuan Blocks

tools.name: av
tools.description:
🗃️ Real databases: rows, columns, cells, views, filters, sorts, relations. Get avID from fs.read or av.search, then get for schema and resolvedRows before editing; use render for view rows. Reuse column IDs and resolvedRows.rowID; sourceBlockID and cell value IDs are different. Never edit database cells through fs/block. Read action help for nested writes.
Actions (required fields): get(avID) · render() · get_attribute_view_keys(avID) · get_attribute_view_filter_sort(avID) · search(keyword) · add_rows(avID) · remove_rows(avID, srcIDs) · add_column(avID, keyName, keyType) · remove_column(avID) · set_cells(avID) · set_column_options*(avID, keyID, options) · duplicate_rows*(avID, sourceRowIDs) · duplicate(avID) · get_primary_key_values(avID) · add_view(avID, blockID, viewID, layout, name) · set_filters(avID, blockID, viewID, filters) · set_sorts(avID, blockID, viewID, sorts) · set_group(avID, blockID, viewID, group) · set_column_visibility(avID, blockID, viewID, keyID, hidden) · set_column_order(avID, blockID, viewID, keyIDs) · set_new_item_templates*(avID, blockID, templates, defaultTemplateID) · create_from_template*(avID, blockID, templateID) · configure_two_way_relation*(avID, blockID, keyID, destinationAvID, backRelationKeyID, sourceName, destinationName) · configure_rollup*(avID, blockID, keyID, relationKeyID, destinationKeyID, calc) · set_relation*(avID, blockID, itemID, keyID, relatedItemIDs)
* = ask the user to confirm first. action="help" (topic=<action>) returns optional fields, nested shapes, and examples.

blockID.description: Optional database block ID for exact context or fallback permission resolution

pageSize.description: Rows per page; use -1 or omit for kernel default

groupPaging.description: Optional group paging map passed through to SiYuan

createIfNotExist.description: Create the default view only when explicitly true; provide blockID when creating a new AV

keyword.description: Keyword to search in attribute view names

blockIDs.description: Existing block IDs to add as bound rows

primaryKeyTexts.description: Plain-text primary key values to add as detached rows

ignoreDefaultFill.description: When true, skip view/group default value filling

srcIDs.description: Bound row block/item IDs to remove

keyID.description: Optional new column key ID; MCP generates one when omitted

previousKeyID.description: Insert after this existing column key ID

removeRelationDest.description: Also remove reverse relation metadata when deleting a relation column

cells.description: Cell updates Read action="help", topic="<action>" before constructing this nested value.

numberFormat.description: Optional number format such as commas, percent, USD, or CNY

date.description: Date/time value as ISO text or epoch milliseconds for valueType=date

endDate.description: Optional end date as ISO text or epoch milliseconds for ranged dates

includeTime.description: When false, store the date without a time component

name.description: Option label; empty option names are rejected before the transaction.

content.description: Asset path stored by SiYuan, e.g. assets/foo.png

sourceRowIDs.description: Canonical AV row item IDs to copy, in source order. Do not pass cell value IDs or bound source block IDs.

name.description: Name for the new view. Creation and naming are sent in one native transaction and read back together.

filters.description: Complete replacement filter tree. [] clears filters and reads back as the semantic empty AND root. Group nesting is capped at 4 levels. Read action="help", topic="<action>" before constructing this nested value.

sorts.description: Complete replacement sort array; [] clears all sorts.

group.description: Read action="help", topic="<action>" before constructing this nested value.

hidden.description: Whether the column is hidden in the carrier-selected view

keyIDs.description: Complete column key order for the current table, gallery, or kanban layout.

templates.description: Complete ordered replacement template array Read action="help", topic="<action>" before constructing this nested value.

defaultTemplateID.description: Default template ID, or empty to clear it; required because this replaces the complete configuration

destinationBlockID.description: Optional explicit destination database block for permission verification

backRelationKeyID.description: Stable destination reverse relation key ID; created when absent

relationKeyID.description: Existing relation key in the same AV

destinationKeyID.description: Existing key in the relation destination AV

calc.description: Native RollupCalc payload, preserved without invented calculation aliases

itemID.description: AV row item ID; never the bound document block ID

relatedItemIDs.description: Target AV row item IDs; an empty array clears the relation

tools.name: file
tools.description:
📁 Assets, templates, and exports: upload/rename/delete assets, read images for vision (read_image), templates, Markdown/ZIP exports, unused-asset cleanup.
Actions (required fields): upload_asset*(assetsDirPath) · list_templates() · read_template(path) · create_template(path, markdown) · update_template(path, markdown) · delete_template*(path) · save_doc_as_template(id, name) · render(engine) · export_md(id) · export_markdown_snapshot(notebookID) · export_resources(paths) · list_unused_assets() · get_doc_assets(id) · audit_image_refs(id, expectedRefs) · read_image(path) · get_image_ocr_text() · remove_unused_assets*() · rename_asset(oldPath, newName) · delete_asset*(path) · extract_doc(id)
* = ask the user to confirm first. action="help" (topic=<action>) returns optional fields, nested shapes, and examples.

localFilePath.description: Local file path. CLI/Node stage its bytes automatically when the kernel coordinator is enabled (maximum 10 MiB).

uploadSource.description: Opaque source returned by the authenticated kernel /transfer/upload endpoint; expires after 10 minutes. Supply instead of localFilePath.

confirmLargeFile.description: Set to true only after the user explicitly confirms uploading a file larger than the configured safety threshold.

query.description: Optional keyword used by SiYuan's template picker. Omit or pass an empty string to list all templates.

path.description: Template path returned by list_templates, /data/templates/... path, /templates/... static path, or path relative to data/templates

offset.description: Character offset for partial template source reading, default 0

markdown.description: Full Markdown template source to write.

overwrite.description: When true, replace an existing template at the same path. Defaults to false.

id.description: Document ID to save as a root-level template.

name.description: Root template name. Slashes are not supported; .md suffix is optional.

preview.description: When engine="template", ask SiYuan to render preview DOM instead of insertion DOM.

notebookID.description: Notebook ID that owns every exported document

roots.description: Notebook-local storage paths to enumerate (use / for notebook roots)

cursor.description: Opaque continuation cursor returned by the previous page

delivery.description: Kernel response delivery. download returns a manifest for authenticated client-side saving without embedding binary data.

paths.description: Workspace-relative file paths to export (e.g., /data/20240318112233-abc123.sy/ or /assets/foo.png)

outputPath.description: Optional local absolute or relative filesystem path to save the exported ZIP

assetType.description: Filter asset type: 'all' (default) returns all assets, 'image' returns only image assets.

expectedRefs.description: Expected image references from source Markdown; no local file is read.

documentPath.description: Human-readable fs document path, including the notebook name, that references the image

outputDir.description: Output root directory. Defaults to ~/siyuan-extracted/ (resolved to absolute path).

tools.name: search
tools.description:
🔍 Workspace content discovery: fulltext for keywords/syntax/regex, semantic for meaning, query_sql for SELECT queries (add LIMIT; table blocks), backlinks and refs. Use fs.search for Markdown lines under a known path, document.search_docs for titles, av.search for database names. Read matched content before editing; find_replace is the only write.
Actions (required fields): fulltext(query) · semantic(query) · query_sql() · get_backlinks(id) · search_refs(id) · find_replace*(k, r, ids) · search_assets() · fulltext_asset_content() · list_invalid_refs()
* = ask the user to confirm first. action="help" (topic=<action>) returns optional fields, nested shapes, and examples.

methodName.description: Semantic alias for method: "keyword" | "query_syntax" | "sql" | "regex". The short alias "query" also maps to query syntax and overrides method when both are provided.

types.description: Block type filter. Accepts full names (e.g. {"heading": true}) or shortcodes (e.g. {"h": true, "p": true}). Codes: d=document, h=heading, p=paragraph, l=list, i=listItem, b=blockquote, c=codeBlock, m=mathBlock, t=table, s=superBlock, html=htmlBlock, embed=embedBlock, av=databaseBlock.

typeShortcodes.description: Alternative shorthand type filter as array: ["h","p"]. Merged with types if both provided.

paths.description: Restrict search to specific notebook IDs or storage paths

sortBy.description: Semantic sort alias: "relevance", "date", "updated_desc", "updated_asc", "created_desc", "created_asc", or "type". Overrides orderBy if both provided.

parentId.description: Post-filter results to blocks whose root_id or parent_id matches this ID, scoping search within a document subtree.

hasTags.description: When true, only return blocks that have tags. When false, only return blocks without tags.

stmt.description: SQL SELECT statement to execute against the blocks/spans/assets tables; returned rows are permission-filtered

sql.description: Semantic alias for stmt. Overrides stmt when both are provided.

id.description: Block or document ID to find backlinks for

refTreeID.description: Optional document tree ID to narrow backlink scope

scopeRootId.description: Semantic alias for refTreeID. Overrides refTreeID when both are provided.

beforeLen.description: Context length before the reference, default 512

isDatabase.description: Whether the reference target is a database

r.description: Replacement text; use empty string to delete matches

ids.description: Document or block IDs to mutate

replaceTypes.description: Replace target kinds such as text, code, docTitle, blockRef

assetId.description: Asset content ID for an exact content lookup

queryMethod.description: Query method for assetId lookup: 0=keyword, 1=query syntax, 2=SQL, 3=regex
